title: Packaged food lookup
summary: Label nutrition for branded products from Open Food Facts.
description: A packaged product has a label; an estimate of it is worse than reading it. Both the diary agent and the coach can look a product up in the free Open Food Facts database.

requirements.text: The diary agent and the coach can search Open Food Facts by product name or barcode.
Only the query (a product name or barcode), the user's country and preferred languages are sent to Open Food Facts; never a photo.

history.text: Only the product name or the barcode is sent to Open Food Facts; never a photo or personal data.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: the country and languages are sent too, to rank local products first.

requirements.text: When the diary agent logs a looked-up product, label values win and the model estimates only the nutrients the label lacks.

history.text: Nutrients missing from the label are estimated by the model.
history.reason: Version 1 implied the coach logs meals too; only the diary agent does.

requirements.text: Label nutrition is mapped onto Tally's nutrient keys, per 100 g and per serving.
A barcode in a capture's photo is decoded on the device and looked up before the model sees the capture.
